ValidationRule.description: This is the validation, when Apple Case - 'Stolen/ Sold Device' type is closed : SEID,Date of stolen / sold device, Token Status is mandatory
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: TEXT(Type) = 'Apple Pay' && TEXT(Sub_Type__c) = 'Stolen/Sold Device' && OR ( ISBLANK( SEID__c) , ISBLANK(TEXT(Apple_Pay_Closure_Reason__c )), ISBLANK(Date_of_Stolen_Sold_Device__c), ISBLANK(TEXT(Token_Status__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(Transaction_post_device_Stolen_Sold__c))) && TEXT( Status ) = 'Closed'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: SEID, 'Date Stolen/Sold Device', 'Transaction Post device Stolen/ Sold', 'Token Status' and 'Closure Reason' are mandatory while Closing the 'Stolen/ Sold Device' case.
